topic: Proper real-data Hs study (no estimates): the composition of the world's economic weight (the backing of the monetary systems) over time -- shares, arrow, momentum, concentration, and laminar-vs-turbulent flow regimes, at two levels (countries + blocs).
purpose: Answer 'compose how the world monetary systems move and churn over time' with REAL public data and a deterministic compositional read -- not an estimate.
paths_note: key_files relative to THIS folder; join_the_chain relative to the Hs repo root.
status: BUILT / STUDY -- one receipted run on real World Bank GDP (world_composition_study.py, d03048c3). Descriptive, not a forecast or financial advice.

specific_knowledge.what: World Bank GDP current US$ (NY.GDP.MKTP.CD), 10 largest economies, 2009-2023, fetched live. Read as a composition over time: shares; clr-velocity arrow (helmsman); momentum (mass x velocity); effective dimension (perplexity of shares = concentration); flow regime via 3-yr tortuosity of the clr trajectory (1=laminar, >1 turbulent); level-2 bloc composition (North America / Europe / Asia / Latin America) = composition of compositions.
key_points: China share 12.9%->25.7% (doubled); Japan 13.2%->5.9% (more than halved); US 36.1%->38.4% (steady-dominant). Europe declining, India rising.
Concentration: effective dimension 7.3->6.2 of 10 -> the world's economic weight is CONCENTRATING toward a US-China duopoly; bloc eff-dim 3.36->3.17 of 4.

Flow regime (tortuosity): laminar in calm years, TURBULENT 2015-2018 (2.08; China slowdown/yuan, Brexit, trade) and 2019-2022 (1.81; COVID+inflation+yen) -- turbulence found in the geometry where macro history puts it.

Arrow = China rising early, Japan FALLING fastest 2020-23 (yen collapse = a ratio-blind moment a scalar 'world GDP up' misses); momentum alternates US/China (mass-blindness: fastest != heaviest). Blocs: weight moves Europe->Asia, North America holding.
specific_knowledge.claim_tiers: T1 = engine + the deterministic reads on real World Bank data (d03048c3); T2 = the regime/turbulence framing + bloc recursion; T3 = any why/forward-looking interpretation. Not financial advice.
